concept: FSx for Lustre: HPC/ML file system linked to S3
tests: Choosing a file system for HPC/ML with extreme throughput and data loading from S3.
expected: Amazon FSx for Lustre linked to an S3 bucket (lazy load and write-back). Triggers: "HPC", "ML training", "hundreds of GB/s", "sub-millisecond latency", "load data from S3".
why_not: EFS Max I/O does not reach Lustre throughput/latency; FSx for Windows is an SMB file server; Transfer Acceleration speeds up uploads to S3 and is not a mountable file system.
